evidence.note: Driver-side front door is visibly closed before the approach.
User grasps the exterior handle; the door is beginning to release.
Door is clearly swung open, exposing the cabin.
Door remains open near the end of the episode.
Door is fully closed again after a distinct disengagement.

events.object_description: Driver-side front door, first door-opening episode

evidence.note: Passenger-side front door is closed before manipulation.
User pulls the exterior door handle.
Door has swung open and the cabin is exposed.
User pushes the open door toward the body.
Door is fully closed.

events.object_description: Passenger-side front door, separate opening episode on the opposite side

evidence.note: Hood is fully closed.
User reaches under the front edge to release and lift the hood.
Hood is rising and the engine compartment is becoming exposed.
Hood is fully raised.
User grasps the raised hood to begin lowering it.
Hood is partway down during closure.
Hood is fully closed and aligned with the body.
Rear hatch is closed.
User reaches beneath the rear edge to release the hatch.
Rear hatch is visibly lifting.
Hatch is raised and the cargo compartment is open.
Hatch remains fully open before closure.
User pulls the hatch downward through the closing motion.
Rear hatch is fully closed.

notes: Four distinct localized manipulation episodes are visible. The initial and intervening camera orbits are survey/repositioning traversals and are not counted.
scene_description: A user circles a parked blue Toyota Supra in an outdoor parking lot, sequentially opening and closing both front doors, the front hood, and the rear hatch.
